title: The gallery
text: TV team authors buys, weeks, works daily: NBC sits one level deeper , daypart, Search runs Sunday-start weeks calendarize() bridges onto topline’s Mondays:
code: weeks <- seq(as.Date("2026-04-06"), by = "week", length.out = 13) shape <- c(0.6, 0.8, 1, 1.1, 1.2, 1.2, 1.1, 1, 1, 0.9, 0.8, 0.7, 0.6) base_wk <- c(TV = 90000, Search = 45000, Social = 30000, Audio = 12000)  top_df <- expand.grid(week = weeks, channel = names(base_wk),                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE) top_df$planned_spend <- round(base_wk[top_df$channel] *                                 shape[match(top_df$week, weeks)])  topline <- media_plan_from_df(   top_df, grain = "channel", time = "week",   name = "Q2 2026 Brand Plan", advertiser = "Acme", planner = "R. Roe" ) tv <- media_plan_from_flights(   data.frame(     channel = "TV", partner = c("NBC", "NBC", "ESPN", "Hulu"),     flight_start = as.Date(c("2026-04-08", "2026-05-18", "2026-04-20", "2026-05-04")),     flight_end   = as.Date(c("2026-05-10", "2026-06-28", "2026-06-14", "2026-06-21")),     planned_spend = c(280000, 320000, 390000, 210000)   ),   grain = c("channel", "partner"), name = "TV Q2 buys",   nickname = "TV detail", planner = "TV team", status = "to review" ) nbc <- media_plan_from_df(   data.frame(week = rep(seq(as.Date("2026-04-06"), by = "week", length.out = 12), each = 2),              channel = "TV", partner = "NBC",              daypart = rep(c("prime", "daytime"), 12),              planned_spend = rep(c(38000, 12000), 12)),   grain = c("channel", "partner", "daypart"), time = "week",   name = "NBC upfront", status = "approved" )  search <- media_plan_from_df(   data.frame(week = rep(seq(as.Date("2026-04-05"), by = "week", length.out = 13), each = 2),              channel = "Search", engine = rep(c("Google", "Bing"), 13),              planned_spend = rep(c(41000, 6000), 13)),   grain = c("channel", "engine"), time = "week",   name = "Search Q2", nickname = "search", planner = "Search team" )  plan <- revise(   attach_subplan(attach_subplan(topline, attach_subplan(tv, nbc)), search),   status = "approved", approved_on = as.Date("2026-03-30") ) plan_tree(plan) #> Q2 2026 Brand Plan  [approved 2026-03-30]                                       2,315,000 #> ├─ TV                                      TV Q2 buys   flighted  3 line items  1,200,000 #> │  ├─ TV | NBC                             NBC upfront  weekly    2 line items    600,000 #> │  └─ (editable)                                                  2 line items    600,000 #> ├─ Search                                  Search Q2    weekly    2 line items    611,000 #> └─ (editable)                                                     2 line items    504,000

what: The colours a spec is built with — viz_theme
title: The colours a spec is built with — viz_theme
text: Every ec_*() function takes theme. Pass "light" (default) "dark" built-palettes, named list overriding entries — mediaplanr.viz ships client's colours, brand palette supplied rather patched option afterwards.

title: The colours a spec is built with — viz_theme
code: viz_theme(theme = "light")

title: The colours a spec is built with — viz_theme
text: theme "light", "dark", named list overrides. list may set base say palette starts ; without , light.

title: The colours a spec is built with — viz_theme
text: named list: ink, ink_2, ink_3, surface, rule, grid, accent, owner (character vector), topline, status (named character vector).

title: The colours a spec is built with — viz_theme
text: Three roles kept deliberately separate. accent plan's colour. owner categorical ramp assigned subplan keys order attached, subplan colour every chart one plan. status maps mediaplanr::status_levels() — plus "" unset — semantic colours, never reused anything else.

title: The colours a spec is built with — viz_theme
